purpose: Define RMD community-health and contribution surfaces in a form that can later be generalized across the LaurentiuStaicu suite without weakening RMD scientific governance.

evidence_basis.rule: Public repositories benefit from README, license, citation, contribution guidance, code of conduct and security/community practices.
Shared defaults can later be centralized in a public account-level .github repository; repository-local files override defaults where project-specific behaviour is needed.
CONTRIBUTING should make contribution expectations explicit and is surfaced automatically by GitHub.
Issue forms may collect structured information for bugs and scientific/data issues.
Security reporting should use a private channel when enabled; do not encourage public disclosure of vulnerability details.

suite_strategy.interim_strategy: Use RMD as the reference implementation. Keep project-specific scientific issue form local. Later centralize genuinely shared files once an account-level .github repository exists.

code_of_conduct.reason: A code of conduct should only be adopted together with an enforceable reporting/escalation process and an explicit maintainer commitment to enforcement.

security_policy.reason: Do not direct vulnerability details into public issues. Add SECURITY.md after private vulnerability reporting is enabled or another private security contact is chosen.

account_level_defaults.reason: GitHub supports centralized defaults through a public account-level .github repository, but that repository does not currently exist and cannot be created through the active integration.

rmd_scientific_contribution_invariants: Do not convert missing/TBD values to zero.
Do not invent bilateral allocations to close an accounting matrix.
Do not treat provider/access failure as negative scientific evidence.
Do not activate behavioural mechanisms or System Dynamics feedbacks from documentation, code presence or intuition alone.
Do not inspect reserved holdout/prospective outcomes outside their governing contract.
Any change to canonical scientific state must update governing registries/tests together.
Any public version bump must follow the atomic release-versioning contract.
contribution_categories: behavioural mechanism or System Dynamics proposal
